name: Chapter Route - Longest Chapter Name Wraps
description: Seattle / Pacific Northwest is the longest name on the roster, and the hero title is now the city ALONE — the organisation's name moved out of it into the small kicker above, so a title that once ran to 49 uppercase characters and overflowed a 1440px viewport no longer carries that weight. The title still wraps rather than clipping, which is what this entry keeps pinned. It is also a forming chapter, so the kicker reads Chapter - Forming and the page asks for a lead instead of naming one: the same route rendering both halves of the status model, against the longest string it has to survive.
